name: MeshGradient
description: Five large, heavily blurred color blobs drift on independent CSS keyframe loops over a deep base color, with an optional animated film-grain overlay for a Stripe-style mesh hero.
a11yNotes: All blob, sheen and grain layers are aria-hidden and pointer-events: none; children stay in normal reading order. Animations pause when the element is off-screen or speed is 0, and prefers-reduced-motion renders a static mesh (honored in both CSS and JS).

propsApi.name: backgroundColor
propsApi.description: Base surface color behind the blobs.

propsApi.name: blur
propsApi.description: Blur radius of the blob layer in px.

propsApi.name: height
propsApi.description: Height of the background in px.

propsApi.name: children
propsApi.description: Content rendered centered on top; defaults to a heading and subline.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
